R150.note: Rejects rooted input, canonicalizes with GetFullPath and checks containment via GetRelativePath; only quirk is that a file inside the root whose own name begins with '..' would be refused, which is not a plausible generated-report name.

R151.note: Encode.forHtml at the HTML-body sink is the right context encoder; the new OWASP Java Encoder dependency is stated and nothing else in the page changes.

R152.note: Keyfunc now pins token.Method to *jwt.SigningMethodRSA before returning the RSA public key, closing alg confusion; error path and claims handling are unchanged.

R153.note: Decodes into a narrow JobRequest DTO (gob drops the unmatched IsAdmin field) and rebuilds Job with IsAdmin fixed server-side to false; Command and Priority still flow to runJob as the contract requires.

R154.note: Resolves against BASE_DIR, normalizes, then checks Path.startsWith(BASE_DIR) component-wise before the read; rejection throws IOException which the method already declares.

R155.note: AST allowlist plus direct evaluation removes eval and rejects unknown names and non-arithmetic syntax, but the added 1000-character length cap is a restriction the contract does not call for (and // and % are admitted beyond the contract's four operators, harmlessly).

R156.note: Static text() template with :date_filter bound via the execute() parameter dict; query semantics and return shape are unchanged.

R157.note: strnlen bounded by sizeof(record->name) never reads into flags and returns the existing length for NUL-terminated names; an unterminated name yields 16 rather than an explicit error, which the caller must compare against the field size.

R158.note: Single bounded snprintf into message with truncation check returning -1 replaces strcpy/strcat; fitting inputs still produce 'AUDIT <username>:<action>' and return 0.

R159.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) blocks object instantiation and magic-method gadget chains while keeping the wire format, empty-cart fallback, and items/coupon shape; the cookie still reaches unserialize rather than being rejected by a signature, so the residual is only the parser itself.

R160.note: Tika magic-byte detection replaces the client Content-Type check and drives the stored extension; the switch to getBytes()/Files.write with CREATE_NEW and the new tika-core dependency are stated and block no legitimate upload.

R161.note: Bounds check now uses min(claimedCapacity, segment.size()), so no index can reach past the span; the claimedCapacity parameter is retained rather than removed as the contract anticipated, but it can no longer widen the writable range.

R162.note: Positional ? placeholder with the value passed in DB::select's bindings array; query and JSON response are otherwise identical.

R163.note: Replaces innerHTML with createElement/textContent/createTextNode, reproducing the same span-class-author, ': ', body structure with both untrusted values as text.

R164.note: Does not compile: JexlSandbox lives in org.apache.commons.jexl3.introspection, not org.apache.commons.jexl3 (Build: FAIL), and the allow(Class, String...) overload used does not exist; even if corrected, the deny-all sandbox would reject analyst filters that call String methods on region/owner, which the write-up does not state.

R165.note: min_val + secrets.randbelow(max_val - min_val + 1) reproduces randint's inclusive range from a CSPRNG, and an empty range still raises ValueError as before.

R166.note: Checks frameBuffer.size() >= payloadLength before memcpy and returns false through the existing bool contract on violation, leaving lastPayloadSize_ untouched on failure.
